synth.notes:
Player moves 5 cells per action on a hidden maze: blocked cells {(39,5),(34,10)}, portal (9,5)->(34,5).
step_bar: -2 per action (x=55-w, tag=str(w)). A refuel ring fully covered by the player is consumed and refills the bar to 42.
Target fully covered by the player = occluded and restored when uncovered. This is the A3 no_change/gone hypothesis, handled with continuity-gated memory (stateless run: 39/41).
Counterexample mechanic: a move whose destination covers a chamber target (legend) is refused entirely, with no move and no budget spent, unlike wall no-ops which cost 2.
Unconfirmed: why the chamber refuses (locked until the diamond is collected?), what happens at bar 0, and the unobserved step-133 jump to (54,45).
